title: Path-free dynamic-experiment content-object reference
description: Identifies one immutable content object without granting filesystem-location or domain authority. object_id is the graph-local logical identity; object_kind fixes a closed storage role only; sha256 and size_bytes identify its exact stored bytes; semantic_digest identifies its canonical parsed JSON presentation. Runtime validation must recompute every identity from reopened bytes, must never infer a path from this reference, and must use the separate closed role registry before treating a payload as structural or semantic domain data.
